subject: Correction: REG3 reference role ZIPs are test fixtures; refresh canonical agent lineage
body: The role packages named *_REG3_REFERENCE_V2.zip from the first Artifactory NG shadow trial are REFERENCE_ONLY test fixtures and MUST NOT be treated as canonical Duo Open agents. Canonical refresh must derive from the actual live lineage packages: Primary V6 COMM_MODEL SHA-256 47d8301f0d8d48a6dd15bb2123a5cbb305b96347914be7f60f5891e32cb9838c; Manager/Reviewer V4 COMM_MODEL SHA-256 6042a9703a4835ef13a51a8ee31aabef1bffc998756d1fa595fea0081441ffc3; Research V4 COMM_MODEL SHA-256 f174b3e9e9b1b8ef9606e0a8c20a84bf948560575546cafb2fec4fe2645f6c71. Refresh all three from those exact bytes, incorporate the post-APK Artifactory NG state, complete AgentBus snapshot/restore requirements and V3 blueprint, publish exact refreshed ZIPs plus a current registry to the AgentBus Library, and preserve historic packages append-only.
supersedes: Artifactory NG shadow-trial use of *_REG3_REFERENCE_V2.zip as candidate canonical role packages
